subject: Marketplace listing renewal: repricing proposal + SOW/onboarding timeline
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Liz Chen <liz.chen@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace listing renewal: repricing proposal + SOW/onboarding timeline

Liz —

Following up on our renewal window for the AWS Marketplace listing (DL-2026-3348). We reviewed the current fee bands and want to propose a modest repricing plus a short SOW to cover onboarding changes we plan to ship in Q1. Goal is to keep unit economics neutral while improving placement and co-sell eligibility.

Key asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether a fee adjustment from 18% to 15% (net of the marketplace commission) would require a new listing amendment or simple contract addendum?
- We attached a draft SOW that outlines a 6-week onboarding plan (technical validation, listing metadata refresh, co-sell enablement checklist). Can AWS Marketplace Ops sign off on high-level scope and a target start date of Jan 11, 2027?
- Any required procurement docs (PO format, billing contact, or updated MSA redlines) we should route to our Legal/Finance immediately?

Attachments: draft_SOW_Redwood_AWS_20261110.pdf, fee_schedule_proposal_20261110.xlsx

Background context: we expect a 20% ARR uplift from promoted placement if we get co-sell prioritized; keeping the fee slightly lower helps justify joint go-to-market spend. Vanessa/Aditya — flagging for approval and cost modeling. Lauren — can Legal triage the SOW/contract ask if AWS requires vendor amendments?

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0162
From: Liz Chen <liz.chen@amazon.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing renewal: repricing proposal + SOW/onboarding timeline

Rafael —

Thanks for the clear note and the attachments. Quick responses to your asks: 

1) Fee adjustment: moving from 18% to 15% is feasible but will require an amendment to your current listing agreement. We can do a standard amendment (no new MSA) provided the scope of the product and billing entity remain unchanged.

2) SOW/onboarding: the SOW you shared looks good at a high level. Marketplace Ops needs a short internal checklist completed (technical validation, EULA/usage docs, and billing contact confirmation). We can target the Jan 11 start date — please allow a 2-week buffer for Marketplace validation and entitlement checks.

3) Procurement docs: we will need a PO from Redwood for the updated fee schedule and a contact for invoicing. If you anticipate a multi-region billing change, flag that now. Redlines to the MSA are unlikely unless the SOW introduces new liability terms.

Next steps I propose:
- AWS to send a one-page amendment template for the fee change by end of week (11/13).
- Redwood to provide a signed PO + final SOW and the billing contact.
- Marketplace Ops to run technical checklist in parallel (2 weeks).

I'll loop Marketplace Ops on the amendment thread. If you want a short sync (15–20 min) to walk the SOW, happy to do Thursday or Friday next week.

Best,
Liz Chen
Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
liz.chen@amazon.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing renewal: repricing proposal + SOW/onboarding timeline

Quick internal note —

I support the 15% ask if we can get co-sell prioritization and the promotional credits that Liz mentioned during the partner briefing. Two operational points:
- Will Finance be comfortable issuing a PO before the amendment is fully signed? We should confirm pre-approval authority.
- If Marketplace requests a 90-day SLT to validate entitlements, we should lock a fallback pricing (18%) for any months where co-sell is not activated.

Aditya — can you update the forecast with the two scenarios (15% with prioritized co-sell vs 18% baseline) and put the delta into the deal record?

—Vanessa
VP, Partnerships Operations
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing renewal: repricing proposal + SOW/onboarding timeline

Team —

Attached is a short model summary (copied below) and I've updated the HubSpot deal with the two scenarios: DL-2026-3348. Numbers are provisional until we confirm the placement uplift from Marketplace Ops.

Scenario A — 15% fee, prioritized co-sell
- Estimated incremental ARR (12 months): $1.2M
- Net to Redwood after fees: $1.02M
- Incremental GTM spend we can allocate: $120k (50/50 split proposal with AWS)

Scenario B — 18% fee, baseline placement
- Estimated ARR: $1.0M
- Net to Redwood after fees: $820k
- GTM spend: $0 (no co-sell prioritization)

Recommendation: move forward with the amendment request for 15% while including a 90-day performance review clause tied to co-sell metrics (leads generated, joint opportunities). If no baseline is met, revert to 18% for months where co-sell is inactive.

Lauren — please confirm if Legal needs anything else to review the attached SOW and proposed amendment language.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Revenue Operations
aditya_rao@redwood.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Liz Chen <liz.chen@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Ops <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing renewal: repricing proposal + SOW/onboarding timeline

Liz / Marketplace Ops —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clarity. We will:
- Finalize the SOW (Lauren will push redlines by EOD Monday 11/16).
- Issue a PO to match the 15% amendment once we have the one-page amendment doc from AWS. Vanessa will check Finance pre-approval and share a PO contact.
- Agree to the 90-day performance review clause as a safety valve; we'll accept reversion language if co-sell metrics don't materialize.

Can you confirm when we should expect the amendment template from AWS (Liz mentioned by 11/13)? If it slipped, no problem — just want to align calendar for Jan 11 start.

Appreciate the partnership — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Head of GTM Partnerships, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0162
